name: SteelSeries Rival 310 / Sensei
description: Logo and scroll-wheel lighting of the SteelSeries Rival 310 (and its CS:GO Howl and PUBG editions), Sensei TEN (and its CS:GO Neon Rider edition) and Sensei 310. Adapted from OpenRGB's SteelSeriesSenseiController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. The save command and DPI are never touched. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/steelseries-sensei.md.
